source_file: HTAN (phs002371) subset of NCI KF DAC_20NOV2026.xlsx for hackathon demo
method: skill rus-data-use-classifier: group prompt v1.3.1, platform prompt v1.3.1, clinical stage prompt v3; two models (databricks-claude-sonnet-4-6, databricks-gpt-5-1); agreed answers kept, disagreements labelled models differ
how_to_read: Counts are unique statements unless stated; one statement can be used by several requests and studies.
"models differ" means the two models gave different answers; treat as uncertain.
Biology is split into CLINICAL / PRECLINICAL only for statements whose final group is BIOLOGY; clinical topics only for CLINICAL.
first_year = earliest approval year among requests using the statement.
Rejected requests are not included: they were removed before classification. Statuses shown: approved, closed, expired.
